name: cw-development-sync
description: Review and transfer active Codex development snapshots through a CW NAS hub.

interface.shortDescription: Sync reviewed development snapshots through CW.
interface.longDescription: Lets Codex review active Git changes, create encrypted development snapshots, preview remote changes, and apply them conflict-safely across PCs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this project's active development changes and show what CW would sync. Do not publish or apply anything until I approve the preview.
